title: Human Pluripotent Stem Cell Culture on Polyvinyl Alcohol-Co-Itaconic Acid Hydrogels with Varying Stiffness Under Xeno-Free Conditions
protocol: Place 20 g of P-IA into 200 mL of ethanol in a 500-mL conical beaker.
Agitate the mixture on a magnetic stirrer for 24-30 h.
Exchange the ethanol with fresh ethanol every 8-10 h.
Remove P-IA from the ethanol by filtration using a Büchner funnel.
Dry P-IA by vacuum drying at room temperature for 24 h.
Add the polymer (P-IA) slowly into pure water.
Take at least 15 minutes to add the polymer.
Avoid adding solvent into the polymer to ensure complete dissolution.
Agitate the P-IA solution for 1 hour on a hot plate.
Heat the P-IA solution carefully, avoiding temperatures over 95 °C.
Agitate the P-IA solution at room temperature for 48 hours.
Leave the P-IA solution without heating on a hot plate.
Allow the P-IA solution to sit without agitation at room temperature for 20-24 hours.
Prepare the crosslinking solution with 1.0 weight% glutaraldehyde from 25% aqueous glutaradehyde solution.
Add 20.0 weight% Na2SO4 using 99% purity to the crosslinking solution.
Include 1.0 weight% H2SO4 in the crosslinking solution.
For a single 6 or 12 well cell culture plate, add 100 µL of glutaraldehyde solution.
Add 2 g of sodium sulfate for each preparation.
Mix 100 µL of sulfuric acid into the mixture.
Dissolve all components in 10 mL of pure water to complete the crosslinking solution.
Return frozen 50X Essential 8 supplement slowly to room temperature by overnight thawing at 4 °C.
Combine one bottle of 50X Essential 8 supplement with one bottle of Essential 8 basal media.
Separate the prepared cell culture media into aliquots (50 mL each).
Store the separated media in 100 mL centrifuge tubes at -20 °C.
Inject a 1 mL aliquot of P-IA solution into a 35 mm TCP dish for film preparation.
Dry the P-IA containing dish in a 45 °C oven for two days to form a P-IA film.
Immerse the P-IA films into an aqueous crosslinking solution for 0.5 hours.
Continue immersing the films for additional times of 1, 2, 4, 6, 12, 24, and 48 hours as needed.
Rinse P-IA hydrogels with pure water after crosslinking.
Sterilize the P-IA hydrogels by immersion in a 75% ethanol solution for 1 min.
Rinse the P-IA hydrogels in pure water six times.
Keep the P-IA hydrogels in pure water until used for cell cultivation.
Activate the P-IA hydrogels via immersion in an aqueous solution containing EDC and NHS for 1 h at 37 °C or 4 h at 4 °C.
Rinse the P-IA hydrogels with PBS three times.
Immerse the P-IA hydrogels in a PBS solution containing oligopeptide or ECM for 24 h at 4 °C.
Wash the P-IA hydrogels with pure water three times.
Maintain human ES or iPS cells on Matrigel in Essential 8 media in 6 cm dishes using standard protocols.
Incubate near-confluent human ES/iPS cells with 2.0 mg/mL dispase II in DMEM/F-12 media at 37 °C for 8-10 min.
Rinse human ES/iPS cells twice with DMEM/F12 media.
Add 2 mL of DMEM/F12 media to the culture dishes and detach weakly adherent colonies using a cell scraper or pipetting.
Collect the detached human ES/iPS cells into 15 mL centrifugation tubes.
Centrifuge the cells at 160 × g for 5 min at 37 °C.
Discard DMEM/F-12 media and suspend the cells in 1 ml of E8 media.
Count the cell density using a cell counter.
Inoculate ES/iPS cells into new culture dishes after adjusting to an appropriate density (1-5 x 10^4 cells per cm² for passaging).
Add 0.5 mL of 4% paraformaldehyde into each 24 well dish containing hES and hiPS cells for fixation.
Incubate the dishes with paraformaldehyde for 15 min at 4 °C.
Aspirate the paraformaldehyde from each well.
Rinse the cells three times with PBS by aspirating it out after each rinse.
Add 0.5 mL of 0.3% Triton-X 100 solution in PBS to permeabilize cell membranes and incubate for 30 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the Triton-X 100 solution from each well.
Incubate cells with blocking buffer (2% BSA in PBS) for 30 min at room temperature.
Remove blocking buffer by pipetting out.
Add primary antibodies diluted to 1:200 concentration into each well and incubate overnight at 4 °C.
Aspirate the primary antibody solution from each well.
Wash cells three times with 0.05% Tween 20 in PBS at room temperature.
Incubate cells with secondary antibodies diluted to 1:200 concentration in 2% BSA solution for 1 hour at room temperature in the dark.
Wash the cells with 300 µL of 0.05% Tween 20 in PBS solution three times at room temperature in the dark.
Analyze the stained cells by fluorescence microscopy or confocal microscopy.
Rinse human ES or iPS cells with 2 mL of DMEM/F-12 media twice.
Immerse the cells in 1.5 mL of Essential 6 media.
Cut near 80% confluent human ES or iPS cells into approximately 32 pieces using 200 µL tips.
Detach the cells from the dishes by using a cell scraper.
Collect human ES/iPS cells and transfer into a 6-well ultralow attachment dish.
Exchange Essential 6 media by pipetting old media and adding fresh media every 2 days.
Culture the cells in suspension for 2 weeks at 37 °C with 5% CO2.
Transfer EBs to culture on 24-well TCP dishes coated with 0.1 weight% gelatin after they are homogenously suspended in Essential 6 media.
Culture the cells in Essential 6 media for an additional week.
Stain the cells with antibodies against markers of the cells derived from three embryonic germline layers [AFP (endoderm), GFA (ectoderm), β III-Tubulin (ectoderm), and SMA (mesoderm)].
Evaluate the cells by the immunostaining method described above.
Rinse human ES or iPS cells in 6-well plates twice with 2 mL DMEM/F-12 media.
Add 1.5 mL DMEM/F-12 media to the cell culture dishes.
Cut near 80% confluent human ES/iPS cells into approximately 32 pieces using a 200 µL tip.
Detach cells from the dishes by scraping with a cell scraper.
Collect detached cells in a 15-mL centrifugation tube and centrifuge at 160 × g for 5 min at 37 °C.
Suspend the cell pellets in 100 μl DMEM/F-12 media after centrifugation.
Mix suspended cell pellets with an equal volume of Matrigel to create a cell suspension.
Transfer the mixed cell-Matrigel suspension into a pre-cooled syringe at -20°C.
Inject subcutaneously into male NOD-SCID mice (5-8 weeks) at least 3 × 10^6 cells in total.
Dissect teratomas after 5-8 weeks and fix with 4.0% paraformaldehyde solution.
Store fixed teratoma samples at 4°C.
Fix the teratoma tissue with paraffin using a standard protocol.
Slice the paraffin-embedded teratomas for histological analysis.
Stain sliced paraffin-embedded teratomas with hematoxylin and eosin (H&E).
Warm culture media (DMEM containing 1% antimycotic antibiotic and 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS)) to 37 °C in a water bath prior to use.
Warm 0.25% trypsin-EDTA solution to 37 °C in a water bath prior to use.
Warm PBS to 37 °C in a water bath prior to use.
Pipette 10 mL of PBS into each 6-cm culture dish containing human ADS cells.
Add 1 mL of trypsin-EDTA solution (0.25%) to the 6-cm culture dishes.
Incubate the trypsin-EDTA solution at 37 °C for 5 min.
Observe the cells under microscopy to confirm detachment.
Collect detached cells into a 15-mL centrifuge tube.
Add an equal volume of culture media (DMEM containing 1% antimycotic antibiotic and 10% FBS) to the centrifuge tube to neutralize trypsin-EDTA.
Centrifuge the cell mixture at 250 × g for 5 min at 37 °C.
Discard the supernatant carefully by pipetting without disturbing the cell pellet.
Resuspend the cells in culture media.
Seed the cells into new culture dishes (P-IA hydrogels) at an appropriate density (5-10 x 10^3 cells per cm² for passaging).
Warm cultivation media (DMEM/MCDB 201 (2:3) containing 20% FBS, 5 ng/mL bFGF and 1% antimycotic antibiotic) to 37 °C in a water bath prior to use.
Pipette 10 mL of PBS into each 6-cm culture dish containing human AFS cells.
Add 1 mL of trypsin-EDTA solution into 6-cm culture dishes.
Incubate the cells at 37 °C for 5 min.
Observe the cells on 6-cm culture dishes under microscopy to confirm detachment.
Collect detached cells into a 15-mL centrifuge tube.
Add an equal volume of culture media (DMEM/MCDB 201 (2:3) containing 20% fetal bovine serum (FBS), 5 ng/mL bFGF and 1% antimycotic antibiotic) to neutralize trypsin-EDTA.
Centrifuge the cells at 250 × g for 5 min at 37 °C.
Discard the supernatant carefully without disturbing the cell pellet by pipetting.
Resuspend the cells in cultivation media.
Seed the cells at the appropriate density (5-10x10^3 cells per cm^2 for passaging or as indicated) into new culture dishes.
